message.reasoning_content: Bid seems valuable: license income 20-60 alashi. But rivals may outbid. Tie order I'm last (2,1,0). Rival cash 46M and 23.5M. Bid moderate, e.g. 12-15 alashi. Note losing bid returned, so bid aggressively but if win, bid goes to bank and I lose cash but gain license income. License income doesn't affect rank. Expect opponents bid too. I'll bid ~20M (choice 39). Also after bid can still act? "После bid доступно основное действие" — one combined per turn, so bidding consumes action. Losing returns money. Income 20-60 vs losing 20-27 cash — risky if opponents bid low. I'm currently richest (27.5 vs 23.5, 46? Rival 1 has 46M richest). Actually rank matters: prize weights. Bid 15M (choice 34) as compromise.
